Aged Payables — Edit

The Aged Payables report analyzes outstanding supplier invoices by how long they have been unpaid.

This report groups supplier balances into aging periods such as current, 30 days, 60 days, and 90+ days overdue.

Purpose and Benefits

Use this report to effectively manage your cash flow and prioritize which suppliers to pay first.

The aging analysis helps you maintain good supplier relationships by tracking payment deadlines.

By monitoring aged payables, you can avoid late payment fees and take advantage of early payment discounts when offered.

Report Configuration

Configure the report by selecting the report date to determine which invoices are included in the analysis.

Adjust the aging periods to match your business needs and payment terms.

Choose whether to include suppliers with zero balances to see a complete list of all suppliers or only those with outstanding amounts.

Date

Select the date for aging calculations. Today uses the current date, while Custom lets you specify a specific date.

CustomDate

Enter the specific date to calculate aging from when using Custom date type.

Division

Select a division to filter the report to show only payables for that division.

Sort By

Select how to sort the report: by supplier name or by total amount owed.

Description

Enter an optional description for this report configuration.

Show Invoices

Check this box to show individual invoice details for each supplier.
